# One checkout-relative path per line. A trailing / covers every test beneath a
# directory. A plain entry marks expected failures. "# SKIP: reason" skips the
# consecutive paths directly below it.
# A "# PASS/FAIL: reason" group accepts either JavaScript outcome.
# A blank line or comment ends the group.
# An unexpected pass or a missing path fails the suite.
# When Ekuma follows a specification, name the rule and what the test expects.

# A fixed clock makes all three elapsed times zero. V8 skips this benchmark
# as flaky and slow (v8:13649).
# SKIP: requires collatorTime < cachedTime < nonCachedTime
test/intl/overrides/caching.js

test/intl/break-iterator/subclass.js

test/intl/break-iterator/zh-break.js
test/intl/default_locale.js
test/intl/general/constructor.js
test/intl/general/supported-locales-of.js

# Ekuma follows TC39's decision to ignore islamic-rgsa in Intl.DateTimeFormat.
# ECMA-402 ResolveLocale omits the unsupported calendar from the resolved
# locale. V8 expects both en and ar to retain the -u-ca-islamic-rgsa extension.
# https://github.com/tc39/proposal-intl-era-monthcode/pull/99
test/intl/date-format/check-ca-option.js

# Ekuma follows CreateDateTimeFormat as amended by Temporal and preserves the
# supplied IANA identifier in resolvedOptions(). V8 expects UTC for GMT and Zulu.
test/intl/date-format/timezone.js
test/intl/regress-1177623.js

# Ekuma follows ECMA-402 ResolvePlural and rounds the full input. V8 rounds the
# scaled significand and uses the scientific exponent for CLDR's compact
# exponent operand.
test/intl/plural-rules/select.js

# Ekuma follows the Intl Era and MonthCode rules for Umm al-Qura's civil
# fallback and BH era. July 22 and 23 of ISO year -195366 fall on 16 and 17
# Dhu al-Hijjah. Arithmetic year -202003 is era year 202004 BH.
# CLDR 49 Arabic inherits "BH" from root. V8 expects -202003 with the AH label.
test/intl/regress-10526.js

# Ekuma follows the Intl Era and MonthCode rule mapping islamic to islamic-tbla.
# Its epoch is 0622-07-18 (1 Muharram 1 AH), so July 17 is 29 Dhu al-Hijjah
# 1 BH. V8 expects 30 Dhu al-Hijjah 0 AH.
# V8 expects both dates for islamic-rgsa too. Ekuma drops that unsupported
# extension and formats July 17 and 18 in the default Gregorian calendar for ar.
test/intl/regress-10527.js

# Ekuma follows CreateDateTimeFormat as amended by Temporal and preserves
# America/Nuuk in resolvedOptions(), as Test262 checks in
# DateTimeFormat/timezone-case-insensitive.js. V8 expects America/Godthab.
test/intl/regress-1074578.js

# Ekuma follows the ECMA-402 language tag grammar. In de-u-22300-true-x-true,
# 22300 and true are Unicode extension attributes and x-true is private use.
# V8 expects a RangeError for this well-formed tag.
test/intl/regress-1427932.js
test/intl/regress-412149700.js

# ECMA-402 uses IANA Zone and Link names. Ekuma rejects US/Pacific-New, which
# is absent from its time zone database. V8 expects the name to be accepted.
test/intl/regress-364374.js

# Object Environment Record HasBinding includes inherited properties. Ekuma's
# strict assignment to the inherited writable binding creates an own global
# property. d8 throws ReferenceError and leaves the property inherited.
test/mjsunit/regress/regress-crbug-1105383.js

# Annex B.3.2.1 preserves the arguments binding outside a block declaring a
# function named arguments. V8 expects the function to replace the arguments
# object.
test/mjsunit/es6/block-sloppy-function.js
test/mjsunit/regress/regress-declare-arguments-maybe-assigned.js

# Sloppy functions have implementation-defined legacy arguments and caller
# properties. V8 expects the original argument value through f.arguments and
# omits these properties from the function's own keys.
test/mjsunit/arguments-indirect.js

# V8's Function.prototype.caller getter returns null for a foreign sloppy
# function. Ekuma's getter throws a TypeError.
test/mjsunit/regress/regress-523431532.js

# The element's toLocaleString returns an array. ToString of that result calls
# join, which can finish by converting the element to [object Object]. V8
# elides the nested array as a cycle.
test/mjsunit/array-tolocalestring.js

# Number::toString uses the shortest significand that rounds to the original
# Number. V8's expected base-5 string rounds to a different Number.
test/mjsunit/number-tostring-big-integer.js

# Iterator.prototype has 16 own string keys in Ekuma. V8 expects 14.
test/mjsunit/es6/iterator-prototype.js

# EnumerateObjectProperties collects enumerable keys from the proxy's
# prototype. V8 rechecks their enumerability through the proxy's descriptor
# trap.
test/mjsunit/es6/proxies-for.js

# HasBinding and GetBindingValue each check the with object's property. V8
# expects a single has trap before get.
test/mjsunit/es6/proxies-with-unscopables.js

# GetValue caches the converted property key in the reference used by
# PutValue. V8 expects compound assignment to convert the key twice.
test/mjsunit/keyed-load-null-receiver.js

# Canonicalize uses Unicode simple case folding with the u and i flags. This
# test expects V8's behavior when built without internationalization.
test/mjsunit/es6/unicode-regexp-ignore-case-noi18n.js

# Function.prototype.toString returns the available source text. V8 falls back
# to native function syntax for a large source offset.
test/mjsunit/harmony/function-tostring.js

# ECMA-402 leaves number symbols to the locale data. Ekuma includes the Arabic
# letter marks in the minus and percent sign parts. V8 expects separate
# literal parts.
test/mjsunit/intl-numberformat-formattoparts.js

# CreateDateTimeFormat as amended by Temporal preserves the supplied IANA
# identifier. V8 expects aliases for the same zone to resolve to one spelling.
test/mjsunit/regress/regress-crbug-364374.js
test/mjsunit/regress/regress-crbug-487322.js

# UpdateLanguageId accepts the posix variant. UTS 35 maps POSIX to the va
# extension during locale identifier conversion. V8 expects that conversion
# when constructing Intl.Locale.
test/mjsunit/regress/regress-549231120.js

# The RegExp legacy static accessors check their receiver, and only input and
# its alias have setters. V8 accepts other receivers and expects setters on
# the read-only captures.
test/mjsunit/fuzz-accessors.js
test/mjsunit/regress/regress-5566.js

# Ekuma rejects the deeply nested pattern in the RegExp constructor. V8
# can reach its regexp compiler's size limit in RegExp.prototype.test.
test/mjsunit/regress/regress-484904778.js

# V8 expects Iterator.concat to call the inner iterator's return method
# when its next method throws. Ekuma propagates the exception directly.
test/mjsunit/harmony/iterator-concat.js

# The computed auto-accessor's getter string includes its name in Ekuma.

# in a time or zone also produce different results.
